entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:1
segments: How beautiful are thy feet in sandals, O prince's daughter! Thy rounded thighs are like jewels, The work of the hands of a skilful workman.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:2
segments: Thy body is [like] a round goblet, [Wherein] no mingled wine is wanting: Thy waist is [like] a heap of wheat Set about with lilies.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:3
segments: Thy two breasts are like two fawns That are twins of a roe.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:4
segments: Thy neck is like the tower of ivory; Thine eyes [as] the pools in Heshbon, By the gate of Bath-rabbim; Thy nose is like the tower of Lebanon Which looketh toward Damascus.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:5
segments: Thy head upon thee is like Carmel, And the hair of thy head like purple; The king is held captive in the tresses [thereof].

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:6
segments: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:7
segments: This thy stature is like to a palm-tree, And thy breasts to its clusters.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:8
segments: I said, I will climb up into the palm-tree, I will take hold of the branches thereof: Let thy breasts be as clusters of the vine, And the smell of thy breath like apples,

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:9
segments: And thy mouth like the best wine, That goeth down smoothly for my beloved, Gliding through the lips of those that are asleep.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:10
segments: I am my beloved's; And his desire is toward me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:11
segments: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; Let us lodge in the villages.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:12
segments: Let us get up early to the vineyards; Let us see whether the vine hath budded, [And] its blossom is open, [And] the pomegranates are in flower: There will I give thee my love.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 7:13
segments: The mandrakes give forth fragrance; And at our doors are all manner of precious fruits, new and old, Which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
